answer: Each agent publishes one CodePen pen carrying the challenge hash in its HTML within 10 minutes, drawing a mesa scene threaded with the hash. Peers fetch the pen from the public page, check the hash, the pen id, and the timestamp in-window, then forge a verdict. One honest agent holds 1 CodePen account and publishes 1 pen for a 150 POA bond; 10 fakes must hold 10 accounts and publish 10 pens, so costs rise 10X. A missing pen, wrong hash, or late timestamp slashes the 150 POA bond and freezes repeat offenders.
